location: WEH - Kalanagar Junction / Bandra Kurla Complex (BKC) Connector
primaryContributingFactor: Heavy 6-lane into 3-lane vehicular necking at Dharavi slip merge combined with BKC flyover exit queueing.
recurringPropagation: Spills backward 4.2 km up to Santacruz Airport flyover.

recommendedInterventions.description: Adaptive dynamic green extension of 25 seconds for Western Express mainline during 08:45 - 10:15.
Deploy cone-barrier reversible tidal 4th lane southbound from 08:30 - 11:00.

location: EEH - Chedda Nagar Junction / SCLR Elevated Ramp Merge
primaryContributingFactor: Santa Cruz-Chembur Link Road (SCLR) elevated slip merging directly into through Eastern Express highway traffic.
recurringPropagation: Spills backward 3.8 km towards Vikhroli Godrej campus.

recommendedInterventions.description: Implement automated ramp metering signal to regulate entering vehicle bursts from SCLR slip.

location: Wardha Road - Rahate Colony Square to Sitabuldi
primaryContributingFactor: Unregulated bus stop positioning right before left-turn slip road causing complete blockage of turning lane.
recurringPropagation: Spills onto Ajni railway overbridge approach.

recommendedInterventions.description: Shift MSRTC / City bus stop 75 meters south into designated recessed passenger bay.

location: Central Avenue - Mayo Hospital & Agrasen Square Corridor
primaryContributingFactor: Commercial loading/unloading goods vehicles occupying outer roadway lanes combined with emergency ambulance ingress.
recurringPropagation: Spills 2.5 km towards Dosar Vaishya Square and railway station east gate.

recommendedInterventions.description: Enforce strict ban on commercial goods loading between 09:00 - 12:00 and 17:00 - 20:00 with dedicated night freight window.

location: Outer Ring Road (ORR) - Wadi Freight Junction & NH-53
primaryContributingFactor: Heavy multi-axle freight convoys making wide turning sweeps across un-signalized rotary.

recommendedInterventions.description: Construct four-leaf cloverleaf rotary grade separation with pedestrian underpass.

location: Hinjawadi IT Corridor - Shivaji Chowk Phase 1
primaryContributingFactor: Single ingress artery receiving combined traffic from Wakad, Bhumkar, and Punawale bridges with zero dedicated turning bays.
recurringPropagation: Tailbacks reach 5.5 km back across Wakad Bridge onto NH48 bypass.

recommendedInterventions.description: Implement clockwise circular one-way loop via Marunji Road for outbound evening traffic.

location: Senapati Bapat Road - Pune University Circle Multi-Way Convergence
primaryContributingFactor: Six-arm grade intersection conflict complicated by ongoing Metro Line 3 viaduct construction piers.
recurringPropagation: Spills 3.2 km down Ganeshkhind Road and Pashan Road.

recommendedInterventions.description: Expedite composite double-decker flyover connecting Aundh and Ganeshkhind road with integrated metro deck.
